title: Quantity correction via replace_item propagates to the real persisted order
notes: Regression for a real production bug: 'No the coke is going to be 3 cokes not one' has none of ORDER_ADD's trigger words (add/plus/another/extra), so intent_router returns None and the deterministic mutation guard never runs. This fixture proves the HAPPY PATH -- when the LLM correctly returns replace_item for this phrasing, the quantity really does propagate through the cart, the re-lock-before-checkout logic, and into the final persisted order. See conv_231 for the companion regression proving the guard added for the hallucination case.
